content: Yeisuw isiw in ven Yelusalem

Yeisuw inoun in wunsiyas ven Betepeig o Betaniy, walasin koy yagan Oliv, kakita mo bisap Yelusalem waseg. Mapuna mo idibakes navamul asteiy va̱gan bimugwas kid bineis ven wunkakit, ilana, “Kuneis ven towen wamatads, bukusiws wanuwan mo bukuba̱nes donkiy na̱tan, kayon niyawanis vatul waseg, gamag nag itotouws waseg. Igaw. E, bukuba̱nes mo kulikus vitulen, kutokes kumeyes.
“Kukin teitan gamag bilivan, bilana, ‘Aveiyag wawun kulikus donkiy na̱wen?’ kulansa, ‘Tanuwagan sivinan. Nawotet biyakous, mo biyamen.’”
Inounas tasiyas mo iba̱nes donkiy wavtakon ven, niyawanis kayon wamatan koukwed nititoy, mo ilikus vitulen.
Ilikus vitulen, tage gamag mwasanin nitablawaws wadadan ilivans gog, ilansa, “Aveiyag wawun kulikus donkiy mana̱wen?”
Mo ikatimapus ages ma̱wana Yeisuw nikatimlakes; ilivans ma̱wan, mo itams.
Itams tasiyas, mo imeyes donkiy waseg Yeisuw, asikweim isenas watapwan mo imwen isin wakunuwatan.
Mwasanin gog asikweim iyaves wa̱ked, mwasanin isa̱ves amweilok yayagein wanawoud iyaves wa̱ked.
Tasiyas tamumugwas sisiyas takkuyeims iwkuwaks, ilansa,
Yeisuw inoun in wunovek Yelusalem, isiw in wanuwan Yowbad nabunatum bunavakaein, ikin palatan palatan, youd babaw ikikin ikous, mo iyum ineis Betaniy siney navamul; bo iboug.
Ikawtun yaveinun
Iyam nen ga̱boug ilisawes Betaniy bineis Yelusalem, ivag anamoun.
Anamoun, ikin kadiveiyov yaveinun nitet, sam yageivein, idoki anagin biban beikam; iwekey gog nag; makava yageivein. Peinan nag tutan beiwuw. Igaw.
Iw to Yeisuw, ikawtun kay kaywen, ilana, “Adok nag bukuvgavaw beivag anagim, beikams gamag, nag.” Navamul iliganes anilivan towen.
Ikayabes taggimwals wanuwan Yowbad nabunatum
Inounas ineis Yelusalem, isiws wanuwan Yowbad nabunatum mo ikayabes tasiyas taggimmwals wabunatum, siteibol ikatitan tasiyas nikatimapus money dakul waseg, o ikatitan abes tasiyas niggimwals bwabun.
Nag itam va̱gan gamag bikokews kunes wanuwan Yowbad nabunatum.
Ikatimlakes, ilana, “Bukitab wanuwan livan nises mamagina:

content.text: ‘Ven babaw gimgilis bidokes gunbunatum nitoug buntuman.’

content: Tage yakamiy nukuvkakes mamagina buntuman veinaw.”
Tasiyas gog tanuwgwes lun sisiyas takatimlakeins kaleiwag iliganes anilivan, sivines kid ama̱wan bivkakes mo biyablebes; tage iwenes peinan gamag babaw igoulus, sivines biliganes nakageiguy.
Kwayav waseg Yeisuw siney navamul mo ilisawes wunovek.
Yaveinun ikallayag
Iyam nen ga̱boug, ininounas wa̱ked, mo ikines yaveinun bo ikallayaga ikous.
Pita inuway, mo ilivan ilana, “Tamwey, kay kaywen nukwawtun bo ikalayag.”

Iw to Yeisuw, idibakes tasiyas, ilana, “Livan mounid badibakeimiy. Kadiloka kunmises Yowbad va̱gan wotet tawtoun biwtel. Kal yak bukubidek koy towen, kulana, ‘Kunoun kun kumukul wabwanit,’ tage nag beivag nanoum akweiy, bukunamisa-wan, mo bivag ma̱wana amlivan nukulivan.
“Mapuna badibakeimiy, kukin bukukululs bukunitougs Yowbad waseg, kukwakins-wan bisekeimiy, mo bukuba̱nes youd tasiyas.
“Kukin bukunitougs Yowbad waseg, aveiyag gamag asisinap waseg yakamiy kuninuwes, kunumlaves, bikalin nuwamiy. Igaw Tamads walba̱lab mo biwidimiy binumlev amisinap kalbaleb yakamiy.”
Yeisuw nakaleiwag

Wankuyeim mo inounas, vayuwein ineis Yelusalem. Ineis Yelusalem, Yeisuw ininoun wanuwan Yowbad nabunatum, mo iweis tasiyas tanuwgwes lun situwa̱veks sisiyas takatimlakeins kaleiwag sisiyas tammwayas, inekes Yeisuw, ilansa, “Aw-kaleiwag towen? Kal isekeim mukwaleiwag silma̱nin muwotet towen?”
Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Kweitan youd bakatiga̱neimiy, kudibakeigs, mo badibakeimiy silawun gunakaleiwag silma̱nin gunawotet towen.
“E, kudibakeigs silawun Yon inawotet waseg ibapta̱yses gamags. Tabta Tamads walba̱lab isek nawotet towen, o gamag teitan watinow isek nawotet? Kudibakeigs silawun nawotet Yon.”
Iliganes, illivans sisiyas, ilansa, “Kukin bitalansa, ‘Tamads walba̱lab,’ mtowen Yeisuw bikatimop aygads bilana, ‘Aveiyag wawun nag kusimounids waseg mtowen Yon?’
“Tage awoum talansa, ‘Gamag teitan isek nawotet’; mata ge gamag babaw biyagageids, peinan isimounids waseg Yon, idokes palopit tatonen.”
Mapuna ikatimapus Yeisuw aygan, ilansa, “Nag kakakin.” Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Yey-vak ma̱wan, nag badibakeimiy kal nisekeig gunawotet towen.”
